purpose: Define advertised network endpoints/service metadata as descriptive discovery evidence separate from actual listener state, capability validation and authority.

topics.name: Endpoint Advertisement
topics.purpose: Define advertised network endpoints/service metadata as descriptive discovery evidence separate from actual listener state, capability validation and authority.

semantics.liveness_rule: Advertisement does not prove listener currently live.
semantics.capability_rule: Advertised features/capabilities require validation before use.
semantics.authority_rule: Advertisement does not authorize caller or target.
semantics.conflict_rule: Conflicting advertisements remain evidence and do not overwrite exact service identity.

invariants.rule: Listener, route, endpoint, connection, channel, peer reachability and cryptographic transport evidence never by themselves grant application, data or operation authority.
Inbound network data remains inert until explicit protocol parsing, validation, identity/context resolution, authorization and dispatcher routing succeed.

hard_gates.condition: advertisement treated as live listener proof
